proposed_by: M12c-B1 checkpoint four tooling review. Recommendations only, not editor decisions: a note can add a hold, never clear a flag or a critical signal, and nothing is merged or split.
rules: A valid game identity is not proof of a particular physical release; every record still needs independent human evidence of its physical release.
Different games keep distinct identities; different releases of one game don't become separate games.
Pirate, counterfeit and unauthorized bootleg editions are held and stay out of the standard public catalog.
Verified, legitimately produced aftermarket physical releases are eligible for editorial consideration, whatever their date.
Unreleased prototypes and digital-only titles are never represented as published retail physical releases.
Non-commercial training cartridges and specialized non-retail software are out of scope for the first public catalog.

groups.name: Action Pachio
groups.recommendation: Same game: same title, publisher (Q5139870) and day-precise date (1993-04-09). Propose Q4677134 (the older item, which states a cartridge format) as the canonical identity, adding Q135194451's Japanese title (アクションパチ夫) as an alias. Hold Q135194451 and report the duplicate to Wikidata. An editor decides; nothing is merged.

groups.name: Tower Dream
groups.recommendation: Same game. Q7829649 has the date (1996-10-25), the publisher and the IGDB id; Q132527560 has only the Japanese title (タワードリーム). Propose Q7829649 as canonical, taking the Japanese title as an alias; hold Q132527560.

groups.name: Albert Odyssey II: Jashin no Taidou
groups.recommendation: Same game, split across two items: Q17192216 has the year (1996) and the Japanese title; Q128221862 has the IGDB id and the developer and publisher (Q2298387). Propose Q17192216 (the older item) as canonical, with Q128221862's facts as evidence to verify; hold Q128221862. The release date still needs a precise source.

groups.name: The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends
groups.recommendation: Hold both. Q2473951 covers four platforms with three MobyGames ids: the NES, the Game Boy and the SNES/Genesis games of this name were different games, so the item describes several games. Q16144658 is SNES-only with no ids and a year (1992) that may belong to the NES game. An editor decides which item (corrected) carries the SNES game's identity; the SNES game must not merge with the NES or Game Boy games.

groups.name: Space Ace
groups.recommendation: Different games. Q1081894 is the 1983-84 laserdisc arcade original with twelve platforms and ports; Q117865047 is the SNES-only game (1994, its own developer Q99521312 and MobyGames 24930). Propose Q117865047 as the SNES identity and hold Q1081894's SNES pairing as a probable wrong platform association for that identity. Keep both identities distinct.

groups.name: Scooby-Doo Mystery
groups.recommendation: The SNES and Genesis games of this name were different games. Q3476003 covers both platforms with two MobyGames ids; Q65146861 is SNES-only with the same developer, publisher and date (1995-11). Propose Q65146861 as the SNES identity, with Q3476003 held until an editor confirms its scope; never merge the SNES and Genesis games.

groups.name: Super Momotaro Dentetsu Ⅱ / Ⅲ
groups.recommendation: Distinct games (1991-12-20 and 1994-12-09, different IGDB ids). They only collided under the old key, which dropped "Ⅱ" and "Ⅲ". Keep both. Ⅱ's two IGDB ids are IGDB-side duplicates of one game.
